timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 45-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.45, bnp 1262, creatinine 0.85, hemoglobin 13.6, platelets 264, sodium 139, wbc 7.5; vitals dbp 76-79, heart_rate 80-84, map 90-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 118-123, spo2 96-97, temp 36.7-37
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 28%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.88, hemoglobin 13.7, platelets 260, sodium 139, wbc 8; vitals dbp 74-78, heart_rate 80-84, map 88-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 116-123, spo2 96-98, temp 36.7-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 45-year-old female, length of stay 5 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
